visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing glasses, a tan t-shirt, and a black backpack stands in front of a wooden structure with a sign that reads 'Taiwan Coffee Festival in Yunlin.' He points upwards with an excited facial expression against a backdrop of a grassy field and white event tents under a clear sky. (2) The scene transitions to a reflection in a circular red mirror showing a wide view of a crowded outdoor festival with many people walking on a large lawn surrounded by white tents and green trees. (3) The man is seen from the back drinking from a paper cup while walking toward the festival booths. The lighting is natural and bright daylight. (4) Close-up shots show hands pouring water from a silver kettle into a light blue coffee dripper on a digital scale. Two green and white coffee bean packages are displayed on a shelf. The man takes a sip from his cup and looks satisfied. (5) The man bites into a large croissant inside a brown paper sleeve. A close-up reveals the interior of the pastry filled with dark brown coffee-colored sauce and white cream. (6) The man eats a coffee-flavored macaron from a small white plate. A macro shot shows the crumbly texture of the macaron shell. (7) The man holds a blue bag of snacks with a cartoon bee character and eats one. He points to the bag while talking. (8) He uses a small green plastic spoon to eat chocolate and vanilla gelato from a white paper cup. (9) A sequence of shots shows small souvenir cups, a large informational billboard with event dates '11.01-11.09', and quick cuts of a child in a stroller, a white poodle, and a chihuahua at the festival. (10) The man sits on a picnic mat on the grass, drinking coffee while watching a performance on a distant stage. The video ends with him back in front of the main entrance sign, smiling and gesturing to the camera.
